offline_single_intervention.description: Use short 8m preview on the same camera route only when the emitted near turn lacks camera support; keep lateral speed reserve and existing brake. No simulator rollout performed.
offline_single_intervention.model: constant-curvature from tan(emitted steer)/3.24; center samples2..8m; rigid four corners long[-2.4,+2.6],lat[-1.6,+1.6] along0..8m; camera distance field, not tyre/dynamic certificate
